name: scenario-to-desktop.setpoint-read
purpose: Read the desktop improvement board with external binding condition and explicit missing outcome measures; never equate an available board with desktop maturity.
assumptions: The caller uses the declared scenario bindings and preserves unavailable evidence.
Program success describes the read; it never grants deployment approval.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once on every path.
Read-only: no launch, build, publication, recovery, inference, delegation, or memory write.
Return identifiers and bounded projections; never print logs, configuration, credentials, media bytes, or private endpoints.
The skill table and board have the same nine rows and targets.
Dormant or uninstrumented bindings cannot establish serving health.
Missing performance baselines produce null targets; no historical sample is copied into a live reading.
Learning rows preserve per-context cohorts and missing denominators; targets remain null until comparable baselines exist.

signals.rows: Nine rows: binding-condition, external-friction, desktop-behavior, runtime-performance, pipeline-performance, engineering-quality. Each has row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason; null target means pending baseline. Includes learning-failure-recurrence, learning-success-effort, learning-advice-outcomes.

outputs.evidence: Successfully read binding IDs; selected pipeline or capture identities are in signals.

fixtures.note: Permanent missing measurements and dormant bindings remain visible; neither lowers board execution status.
